first_failure_point: the first model call of every sample: no tool call was ever made, so no view was read and no answer turn was reached

root_cause.observed: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': 'This response_format type is unavailable now (request_id: 3043d202-59b4-434c-b750-6fdeda3dfa92)', 'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'param': None, 'code': 'invalid_request_error'}}
root_cause.mechanism: agents 0.22.3 OpenAIChatCompletionsModel always sends response_format = Converter.convert_response_format(output_schema), and output_schema is the agent's output_type; on this SDK version that path has no model_settings override, so setting Agent(output_type=...) necessarily asks the provider for a json_schema response format
root_cause.why_v13_v14_v15_never_hit_it: those versions validated the final answer as text host-side (a regex plus a character bound), so no output_type was set and the provider never received a response_format parameter
root_cause.why_the_zero_api_checks_could_not_catch_: the plan and stub paths never contact the provider (by design), so a provider capability gap is invisible to them; only a real request could reveal it. This is the first time the v16 host configuration was exercised against the real endpoint

corrected_decomposition.note: the batch report's post_render_over_160_share counts an empty answer as over-length; these samples produced no answer candidate at all, so that share is not a length measurement and must not be read as an over-length rate. The report field needs the fix listed under follow_ups before any later batch is summarised.

attainability: not assessed: no sample reached the answer turn, so nothing about rendering inside facts + frozen regex + 160 characters was measured, and the pre-registered over-length estimate (7.7 percent under the old contract) remains the only basis

options_for_the_user.contract_effect: none on the answer contract: the model still returns issue/cause/fix/facts and the host still renders the RESULT line; only the enforcement point moves from the provider to the host, which never trusted the provider anyway
